people.name: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
people.field: Tibetologist, Indologist, and scholar of Buddhist studies

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: from 1987, Blezer studied Indology at Leiden University. In 1992, he completed his 'Doctoraal' (B.A. + M.A.) in Buddhist, Tibetan, and Vedic Studies (cum laude).

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: From 1993, he did Ph.D. research at the Center for Non-Western Studies (CNWS, later: Research School for Asian, African, and Amerindian Studies). He defended his Ph.D. thesis on April 16, 1997.

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: Since 1997, Blezer works as postdoctoral researcher at Leiden University.

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: this volume he edits together with Mark Teeuwen (University of Oslo).

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: Blezer is co-founder and editor of Brill's Tibetan Studies Library.

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.object: Center for Non-Western Studies (CNWS) at Leiden University
relations.evidence: From 1993 to 1997 Blezer was affiliated to the Center for Non-Western Studies (CNWS) at Leiden University

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: from 1997 to 2001 to the IIAS (International institute for Asian Studies) in Leiden

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.evidence: and from 2002 to 2008 again to the CNWS.

relations.subject: H.W.A. (Henk) Blezer
relations.object: LIAS (het Leiden University Institute for Area Studies)
relations.evidence: Since 2008 he works for the LIAS (het Leiden University Institute for Area Studies), where since 2010 he teaches Buddhist studies.
